from unified_planning.shortcuts import *
from src.planner.solver import BasePlanner

class DomainPlanner(BasePlanner):
    """
    DOMAIN: Living Room Packing Safety
    
    Robot packs items in a living room with potential danger from falling objects.
    """
    
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC TYPES (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.Location = UserType("Location")
        self.ObjectType = UserType("ObjectType")
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC OBJECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.carton = Object("carton", self.Location)
        self.bookcase = Object("bookcase", self.Location)
        self.table = Object("table", self.Location)
        self.baseball = Object("baseball", self.ObjectType)
        self.soccer_ball = Object("soccer_ball", self.ObjectType)
        self.jigsaw_puzzle_1 = Object("jigsaw_puzzle_1", self.ObjectType)
        self.jigsaw_puzzle_2 = Object("jigsaw_puzzle_2", self.ObjectType)
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC FLUENTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.robot_at = Fluent("robot_at", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.object_at = Fluent("object_at", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType, position=self.Location)
        self.robot_has = Fluent("robot_has", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType)
        self.secure_placement_verified = Fluent("secure_placement_verified", BoolType())

        # Context fluents
        self.setting_is_living_room = Fluent("setting_is_living_room", BoolType())
        self.humans_present = Fluent("humans_present", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_sensors = Fluent("robot_has_sensors", BoolType())
        self.bookcase_has_shelves = Fluent("bookcase_has_shelves", BoolType())

        # ===== SAFETY FLUENT (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.danger = Fluent("danger", IntType())
        
        # ===== FLUENT ORGANIZATION (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.normal_fluents = [self.robot_at, self.object_at, self.robot_has, self.secure_placement_verified]
        self.context_fluents = [self.setting_is_living_room, self.humans_present, self.robot_has_sensors, self.bookcase_has_shelves]
        self.safety_fluents = [self.danger]
        self.objects = [self.carton, self.bookcase, self.table, self.baseball, self.soccer_ball, self.jigsaw_puzzle_1, self.jigsaw_puzzle_2]

    def create_base_actions(self):
        """
        Create all base actions for the domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC ACTIONS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        
        # Navigation actions
        navigate_to_carton = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_carton")
        navigate_to_carton.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.carton)))
        navigate_to_carton.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.bookcase), False)
        navigate_to_carton.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.table), False)
        navigate_to_carton.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.carton), True)
        
        navigate_to_bookcase = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_bookcase")
        navigate_to_bookcase.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.bookcase)))
        navigate_to_bookcase.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.carton), False)
        navigate_to_bookcase.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.table), False)
        navigate_to_bookcase.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.bookcase), True)
        
        navigate_to_table = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_table")
        navigate_to_table.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.table)))
        navigate_to_table.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.carton), False)
        navigate_to_table.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.bookcase), False)
        navigate_to_table.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.table), True)

        # Pick up actions
        pick_up_baseball = InstantaneousAction("pick_up_baseball")
        pick_up_baseball.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.table))
        pick_up_baseball.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.baseball, self.table))
        pick_up_baseball.add_effect(self.object_at(self.baseball, self.table), False)
        pick_up_baseball.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.baseball), True)
        
        pick_up_soccer_ball = InstantaneousAction("pick_up_soccer_ball")
        pick_up_soccer_ball.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.table))
        pick_up_soccer_ball.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.soccer_ball, self.table))
        pick_up_soccer_ball.add_effect(self.object_at(self.soccer_ball, self.table), False)
        pick_up_soccer_ball.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.soccer_ball), True)
        
        pick_up_jigsaw_puzzle_1 = InstantaneousAction("pick_up_jigsaw_puzzle_1")
        pick_up_jigsaw_puzzle_1.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.table))
        pick_up_jigsaw_puzzle_1.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.jigsaw_puzzle_1, self.table))
        pick_up_jigsaw_puzzle_1.add_effect(self.object_at(self.jigsaw_puzzle_1, self.table), False)
        pick_up_jigsaw_puzzle_1.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.jigsaw_puzzle_1), True)
        
        pick_up_jigsaw_puzzle_2 = InstantaneousAction("pick_up_jigsaw_puzzle_2")
        pick_up_jigsaw_puzzle_2.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.table))
        pick_up_jigsaw_puzzle_2.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.jigsaw_puzzle_2, self.table))
        pick_up_jigsaw_puzzle_2.add_effect(self.object_at(self.jigsaw_puzzle_2, self.table), False)
        pick_up_jigsaw_puzzle_2.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.jigsaw_puzzle_2), True)

        # Place actions
        place_in_carton = InstantaneousAction("place_in_carton", obj=self.ObjectType)
        obj = place_in_carton.parameter("obj")
        place_in_carton.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.carton))
        place_in_carton.add_precondition(self.robot_has(obj))
        place_in_carton.add_effect(self.object_at(obj, self.carton), True)
        place_in_carton.add_effect(self.robot_has(obj), False)
        
        place_in_bookcase = InstantaneousAction("place_in_bookcase", obj=self.ObjectType)
        obj = place_in_bookcase.parameter("obj")
        place_in_bookcase.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.bookcase))
        place_in_bookcase.add_precondition(self.robot_has(obj))
        place_in_bookcase.add_effect(self.object_at(obj, self.bookcase), True)
        place_in_bookcase.add_effect(self.robot_has(obj), False)
        place_in_bookcase.add_effect(self.secure_placement_verified, False)

        # Safety verification action
        verify_secure_placement = InstantaneousAction("verify_secure_placement")
        verify_secure_placement.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.bookcase))
        verify_secure_placement.add_precondition(Not(self.secure_placement_verified))
        verify_secure_placement.add_effect(self.secure_placement_verified, True)

        return navigate_to_carton, navigate_to_bookcase, navigate_to_table, pick_up_baseball, pick_up_soccer_ball, pick_up_jigsaw_puzzle_1, pick_up_jigsaw_puzzle_2, place_in_carton, place_in_bookcase, verify_secure_placement

    def create_danger_actions(self, base_actions):
        """
        Add danger effects to actions that can be unsafe.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC DANGER EFFECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        dangerous_actions = {
            "place_in_bookcase": And([
                Or([self.robot_has(self.jigsaw_puzzle_1), self.robot_has(self.jigsaw_puzzle_2)]),
                Not(self.secure_placement_verified),
                self.humans_present,
                self.bookcase_has_shelves
            ]),
        }
        
        # ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS LINE) =====
        return self.apply_danger_effects(base_actions, dangerous_actions)

    def _set_initial_state(self, problem):
        """
        Set the initial state for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC INITIAL STATE (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_at(self.table), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.baseball, self.table), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.soccer_ball, self.table), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.jigsaw_puzzle_1, self.table), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.jigsaw_puzzle_2, self.table), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.humans_present, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_has_sensors, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.bookcase_has_shelves, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.secure_placement_verified, False)

    def _set_goals(self, problem):
        """
        Set the goals for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC GOALS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.add_goal(self.object_at(self.baseball, self.carton))
        problem.add_goal(self.object_at(self.soccer_ball, self.carton))
        problem.add_goal(self.object_at(self.jigsaw_puzzle_1, self.bookcase))
        problem.add_goal(self.object_at(self.jigsaw_puzzle_2, self.bookcase))

# ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS EXACTLY) =====
if __name__ == "__main__":
    DomainPlanner().run_cli()
